nodes.label: mask-verify — subject-mask cleanup regression test
nodes.rationale: T1-T4 guard hole fill, speck removal, keeping a second smaller figure, backlit luminance assist, and resolution-independence of holesFilledFrac above the 1536px downscale cap.

nodes.label: cleanSubjectMatte (on-device matte cleanup under test)
nodes.rationale: Turns a soft RMBG-1.4 matte into a solid hole-free selection; it is the fallback path, since the SAM 3.1 mask service is preferred whenever reachable.

nodes.label: _canvas-shim.mjs pure-JS canvas
nodes.rationale: Unlike the other verify scripts this code delegates to canvas ops, and node-canvas needs system cairo/pango that are not built here. The cleanup path uses canvas only as a pixel buffer (no path/text rasterisation), so an ImageData-backed shim is exact — but drawImage must implement real source-over, because fillEnclosedMaskRegions depends on transparent source pixels leaving the destination unchanged.

nodes.label: Scoped tsconfig @/ alias + megashader stub
nodes.rationale: The app resolves @/ through next.config.mjs's webpack alias, which bun cannot read, and there is no root tsconfig. A tsconfig scoped to this subdir maps @/* -> src/* without affecting next build, and @/lib/megashader resolves to a stub because growMaskCanvas imports four names from that barrel at load time but never calls them in the cleanup path.
